evidence.quote: For this purpose I prefer to pulverize the 90 dried material before reduction and then compress this powder into small compact masses of desired form, such as, for exam- ple, pills.
I have obtained excellent re- sults with pills about one-fourth inch in 95 diameter and about one-eighth inch thick.

props.statement: Methanol forms in substantial amounts at 5 atmospheres and upwards, depending on temperature, and even at one atmosphere, though uneconomically; the best results are between 200 and 300 atmospheres; space velocities of 2,000 to 20,000 (N.T.P.) are preferred.
